CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_set_user_subscription(p_email text, p_plan text, p_expires_at timestamp with time zone, p_admin_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_unlimited_quota boolean DEFAULT false, p_calendar_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_accounting_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_point_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_memory_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_game_question_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_calendar_share_quota integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_image_megabytes integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare target_user_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.life_pilot_is_admin() then raise exception 'admin_required'; end if;
  if p_plan not in ('free', 'plus') then raise exception 'invalid_plan'; end if;
  if p_expires_at is null then raise exception 'expiry_required'; end if;
  if least(p_calendar_quota, p_accounting_quota, p_point_quota,
           p_memory_quota, p_game_question_quota, p_calendar_share_quota,
           p_image_megabytes) < 0 then raise exception 'invalid_quota'; end if;

  select id into target_user_id from auth.users
  where lower(email) = lower(trim(p_email)) limit 1;
  if target_user_id is null then raise exception 'user_not_found'; end if;

  insert into public.user_subscriptions(
    user_id, plan, status, current_period_end, expires_at, updated_at,
    updated_by, admin_note, unlimited_quota,
    calendar_quota_override, accounting_quota_override,
    point_quota_override, memory_quota_override,
    game_question_quota_override, calendar_share_quota_override,
    image_bytes_quota_override
  ) values (
    target_user_id, p_plan,
    case when p_expires_at > now() then 'active' else 'expired' end,
    p_expires_at, p_expires_at, now(), auth.uid(), nullif(trim(p_admin_note), ''),
    p_unlimited_quota, p_calendar_quota, p_accounting_quota,
    p_point_quota, p_memory_quota, p_game_question_quota,
    p_calendar_share_quota,
    case when p_image_megabytes is null then null else p_image_megabytes::bigint * 1024 * 1024 end
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update set
    plan = excluded.plan, status = excluded.status,
    current_period_end = excluded.current_period_end,
    expires_at = excluded.expires_at, updated_at = now(),
    updated_by = auth.uid(), admin_note = excluded.admin_note,
    unlimited_quota = excluded.unlimited_quota,
    calendar_quota_override = excluded.calendar_quota_override,
    accounting_quota_override = excluded.accounting_quota_override,
    point_quota_override = excluded.point_quota_override,
    memory_quota_override = excluded.memory_quota_override,
    game_question_quota_override = excluded.game_question_quota_override,
    calendar_share_quota_override = excluded.calendar_share_quota_override,
    image_bytes_quota_override = excluded.image_bytes_quota_override;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_question_group_counts(p_table_name text, p_level bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(question_group text, question_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  if p_table_name not in (
    'game_grammar',
    'game_sentence',
    'game_translation'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Unsupported question table';
  end if;

  return query execute format(
    'select
       trim(q."group") as question_group,
       count(*)::bigint as question_count
     from public.%I q
     where q.owner_id = auth.uid()
       and q.is_active = true
       and q.level <= $1
       and q."group" is not null
       and trim(q."group") <> ''''
     group by trim(q."group")
     order by trim(q."group")',
    p_table_name
  )
  using p_level;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_recommendation_submission_usage()
 RETURNS TABLE(resource text, used bigint, quota bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with account as (
    select public.life_pilot_user_email() as email
  ), entitlement as (
    select * from public.life_pilot_personal_recommendation_entitlement()
  )
  select 'recommended_events'::text, count(event.id)::bigint,
         entitlement.recommended_event_quota
  from entitlement cross join account
  left join public.recommended_events event
    on lower(trim(event.account)) = account.email
   and coalesce(event.end_date, event.start_date)::date >= current_date
  group by entitlement.recommended_event_quota
  union all
  select 'recommended_attractions'::text, count(attraction.id)::bigint,
         entitlement.recommended_attraction_quota
  from entitlement cross join account
  left join public.recommended_attractions attraction
    on lower(trim(attraction.account)) = account.email
   and coalesce(attraction.end_date, attraction.start_date)::date >=
       current_date
  group by entitlement.recommended_attraction_quota;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_subscription_pricing_versions()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, version_name text, storage_plan text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, quarterly_price_twd integer, calendar_quota integer, accounting_quota integer, point_quota integer, memory_quota integer, game_question_quota integer, calendar_share_quota integer, recommended_event_quota integer, recommended_attraction_quota integer, image_megabytes integer, answer_history_days integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    version.id,
    version.version_name,
    version.storage_plan,
    version.effective_at,
    version.quarterly_price_twd,
    version.calendar_quota,
    version.accounting_quota,
    version.point_quota,
    version.memory_quota,
    version.game_question_quota,
    version.calendar_share_quota,
    version.recommended_event_quota,
    version.recommended_attraction_quota,
    version.image_megabytes,
    version.answer_history_days
  from public.subscription_pricing_versions version
  order by version.effective_at desc, version.version_name;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_vendor_pricing_versions()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, plan_code text, version_name text, effective_at timestamp with time zone, quarterly_price_twd integer, event_quota integer, attraction_quota integer, image_megabytes integer, analytics_days integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select distinct on (v.plan_code)
    v.id,
    v.plan_code,
    v.version_name,
    v.effective_at,
    v.quarterly_price_twd,
    v.event_quota,
    v.attraction_quota,
    v.image_megabytes,
    v.analytics_days
  from public.vendor_pricing_versions v
  where v.is_active
    and v.effective_at <= now()
  order by
    v.plan_code,
    v.effective_at desc,
    v.created_at desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_ledger_change_proposals(p_share_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, operation text, entry_id text, changes jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.id, p.operation, p.entry_id, p.changes, p.created_at
  from public.ledger_change_proposals p
  join public.ledger_read_shares s on s.id = p.share_id
  where s.id = p_share_id and s.owner_id = auth.uid() and s.allow_change_proposals
    and p.status = 'pending' and public.life_pilot_ledger_share_owner_eligible(s.owner_id)
  order by p.created_at, p.id
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_my_shared_ledgers(p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(share_id uuid, kind text, account_id text, account_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select s.id, s.kind, s.account_id, coalesce(a.account, p.account)::text
  from public.ledger_read_shares s
  join auth.users o on o.id = s.owner_id
  join auth.users r on r.id = s.recipient_id
  left join public.accounting_account a on s.kind = 'accounting'
    and a.id::text = s.account_id and lower(trim(a.created_by)) = lower(trim(o.email))
  left join public.point_record_account p on s.kind = 'points'
    and p.id::text = s.account_id and lower(trim(p.created_by)) = lower(trim(o.email))
  where r.id = auth.uid() and (r.banned_until is null or r.banned_until <= now())
    and public.life_pilot_ledger_share_owner_eligible(s.owner_id)
    and (a.id is not null or p.id is not null)
  order by s.created_at desc, s.id
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 1), 100)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_accounting_detail(p_detail_id uuid, p_new_value bigint, p_new_currency text, p_new_description text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$DECLARE
  v_account_id uuid;
  v_old_value bigint;
  v_old_currency text;
  v_main_currency text;
  v_type text;
BEGIN
  -- 0️⃣ 鎖定明細
  SELECT
    account_id,
    value,
    currency,
    type
  INTO
    v_account_id,
    v_old_value,
    v_old_currency,
    v_type
  FROM accounting_detail
  WHERE id = p_detail_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  -- 0-1️⃣ 防呆：只允許編輯 balance
  IF v_type <> 'balance' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only balance records can be edited';
  END IF;

  -- 1️⃣ 主幣別
  SELECT main_currency
  INTO v_main_currency
  FROM accounting_account
  WHERE id = v_account_id;

  -- 2️⃣ 扣舊幣別
  UPDATE accounting_balance_by_currency
  SET balance = balance - v_old_value
  WHERE account_id = v_account_id
    AND currency = v_old_currency;

  -- 3️⃣ 補新幣別
  INSERT INTO accounting_balance_by_currency (
    account_id, currency, balance
  ) VALUES (
    v_account_id, p_new_currency, p_new_value
  )
  ON CONFLICT (account_id, currency)
  DO UPDATE
  SET balance = accounting_balance_by_currency.balance + EXCLUDED.balance;

  -- 4️⃣ 更新 account.balance（只動主幣別）
  UPDATE accounting_account
  SET balance =
    balance
    - CASE WHEN v_old_currency = v_main_currency THEN v_old_value ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN p_new_currency = v_main_currency THEN p_new_value ELSE 0 END
  WHERE id = v_account_id;

  -- 5️⃣ 更新明細
  UPDATE accounting_detail
  SET
    value = p_new_value,
    currency = p_new_currency,
    description = p_new_description
  WHERE id = p_detail_id;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_accounting_detail_with_date(p_detail_id uuid, p_new_value numeric, p_new_currency text, p_new_description text, p_new_date timestamp with time zone, p_new_primary_category text, p_new_group text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_account_id uuid;
  v_old_value numeric;
  v_old_currency text;
  v_main_currency text;
  v_type text;
begin
  select account_id, value, currency, type
    into v_account_id, v_old_value, v_old_currency, v_type
  from public.accounting_detail
  where id = p_detail_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Accounting detail not found';
  end if;
  if v_type <> 'balance' then
    raise exception 'Only balance records can be edited';
  end if;

  select main_currency
    into v_main_currency
  from public.accounting_account
  where id = v_account_id;

  update public.accounting_balance_by_currency
  set balance = balance - coalesce(v_old_value, 0)
  where account_id = v_account_id
    and currency = v_old_currency;

  insert into public.accounting_balance_by_currency (
    account_id, currency, balance, category
  )
  select v_account_id, p_new_currency, p_new_value, category
  from public.accounting_account
  where id = v_account_id
  on conflict (account_id, currency)
  do update set balance =
    public.accounting_balance_by_currency.balance + excluded.balance;

  update public.accounting_account
  set balance =
    coalesce(balance, 0)
    - case when v_old_currency = v_main_currency
        then coalesce(v_old_value, 0) else 0 end
    + case when p_new_currency = v_main_currency
        then p_new_value else 0 end
  where id = v_account_id;

  update public.accounting_detail
  set value = p_new_value,
      currency = p_new_currency,
      description = p_new_description,
      date = p_new_date,
      primary_category = p_new_primary_category,
      "group" = coalesce(p_new_group, '')
  where id = p_detail_id;
end;
$function$
